description: This file defines the Text class in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, representing text content within a paragraph in a document. It provides constructors, cloning, serialization, and property management for textual data.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Represents text in a paragraph, manages content, cloning, serialization, and internal values.

classes.description: Container for internal nullable value of the Text content property.
